"""Check the new fixed filter on CUDA before any held-out neural forward."""
import json,time
from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
import torch
from demosaic.late_balanced_spatial import SpatialHighpass
from train_directional_bank_trial import ref,save

repo=Path('/home/dllu/proj/demosaic');root=repo/'.cache/quality-20261107/V169-balanced-spatial-v2'
torch.set_num_threads(2);torch.set_num_interop_threads(1)
torch.backends.cuda.matmul.allow_tf32=torch.backends.cudnn.allow_tf32=False
torch.backends.cudnn.benchmark=False;torch.backends.cudnn.deterministic=True;torch.use_deterministic_algorithms(True)
torch.cuda.set_per_process_memory_fraction(12*2**30/torch.cuda.get_device_properties(0).total_memory)
rows=[]
for dtype in [torch.float32,torch.float64]:
 for shape in [(1,3,1,1),(2,3,7,11),(1,3,65,67)]:
  value=np.random.default_rng(16904).normal(size=shape)*1e-5
  cpu=torch.tensor(value,dtype=dtype,requires_grad=True);gpu=cpu.detach().cuda().requires_grad_()
  a=SpatialHighpass()(cpu);b=SpatialHighpass().cuda()(gpu)
  torch.testing.assert_close(a,b.cpu(),atol=2e-11,rtol=2e-5)
  weights=torch.sin(torch.arange(cpu.numel(),dtype=dtype)).reshape(shape)
  (a*weights).sum().backward();(b*weights.cuda()).sum().backward()
  torch.testing.assert_close(cpu.grad,gpu.grad.cpu(),atol=3e-6 if dtype==torch.float32 else 1e-13,rtol=2e-5)
  if dtype==torch.float32:
   with torch.autocast('cuda',dtype=torch.bfloat16):mixed=SpatialHighpass().cuda()(gpu.detach())
   assert mixed.dtype==torch.float32 and torch.equal(mixed,b)
  rows.append(dict(dtype=str(dtype),shape=shape,maximum_value_error=float((a-b.cpu()).abs().max()),maximum_gradient_error=float((cpu.grad-gpu.grad.cpu()).abs().max())))
save(root/'CUDA-filter-admission-v1.json',dict(status='pass-independent-device-value-gradient-and-autocast-filter-checks',rows=rows,new_neural_forwards=0,
    peak_CUDA_allocated_bytes=torch.cuda.max_memory_allocated(),source=dict(ref(__file__),text=Path(__file__).read_text())))
print('PASS6 CPU/CUDA filter value/gradient cases;3 FP32 autocast checks;no neural forwards')
